alpha_hypothesis.playbook_alignment: Tests a new deterministic state-surface quality/risk field, avoiding sparse LLM soft-ranking, broad-market retunes, and candidate-pool noise.

backtest_protocol: docs/backtesting.md canonical three fixed windows; accepted exp-20260520-001 baseline artifact plus default-off state-surface paper overlay replay.

gate3.hard_rule: No filter, ranking, or candidate gate changed; only paper notional changes for already-selected trades.

history_check.anti_repeat: Not an LLM soft-ranking expansion, broad-market threshold retry, global capacity scalar, queue-lag scalar retry, or candidate-pool expansion.
history_check.exp-20260520-001: Accepted low-extension support; this experiment freezes it and tests trend stability after that stack.
history_check.recent_broad_market: exp-20260520-004 was accepted and exp-20260520-005 rejected; this run intentionally avoids another broad-market retune.

hypothesis: Already-selected state-surface paper candidates with steady medium-term trend, measured as ret20_excess_spy - ret60 / 3 <= a small acceleration cap, may deserve a bounded support scalar after the accepted low-extension stack.
interpretation: Trend-stability support improved the default-off state-surface paper overlay without changing core trades, filters, ranking, or live/default orders.

llm_metrics.why_not_llm: LLM soft-ranking data remains sparse/PIT-limited; this tests a replayable deterministic state-surface field.

next_evidence_needed: Collect forward state-surface paper outcomes with trend-stability metadata and avoid nearby acceleration/scalar retries until the sample materially expands.

parameters.condition: selected state-surface paper candidate features.ret20_excess_spy - features.ret60 / 3 <= 0.06
parameters.profile_priority: applies after accepted low-extension support in the default-off paper notional stack

protocol_answers.1_alpha_hypothesis: capital allocation: selected state-surface candidates with steady medium-term trend may deserve a support scalar.
protocol_answers.2_history_check: State-surface low-extension support was accepted in exp-20260520-001; this freezes it and tests a distinct relative acceleration field. Broad-market and LLM lanes are avoided due recent anti-repeat/data limits.
protocol_answers.4_acceptance_standard: docs/backtesting.md three fixed windows; positive aggregate EV/PnL, all three EV-improved windows, zero EV/PnL-regressed windows, adjusted trades >=8 across all 3 windows, max DD drift <=0.5pp, single-ticker positive share <=50%.
